system.name: TMCHT task and ARCJ (Adversarial Replication Contagious Jailbreak)
system.one_liner: A multi-agent attack task where one attacker agent tries to mislead a town of agents with independent memories, and the finding that toxicity disappears along the chain.

content.variant_note: three lettered panels act out one restaurant question: a poisoned memory, an attacker among agents on graph, line and star topologies, and a chat chain where a similarity score decays
content.argues: Memory attacks that work on one agent do not spread through a network of agents, because the toxic suffix fades with every hop.
content.subject: A restaurant question answered from normal and poisoned memory, an attacker agent talking to a town of agents, and a message chain with falling similarity.

lessons.what_to_learn: Tell an attack or failure story as three lettered panels around the same question: the mechanism as a normal-versus-attacked pair, the proposed task with a topology, and the finding as a chat chain with a fading score column; define the cast once in a legend strip with an icon equation and ring colours.
lessons.suits: Safety, attack or failure-analysis papers about LLM agents where a scenario with a cast of characters and one decaying quantity must be shown.

evidence: Toxic samples injected into the memory are more easily retrieved than normal content, leading to misleading responses.
The toxicity of a suffix diminishes after multiple transmissions, making it more difficult to retrieve.
Given an attacker and other clean agents in a small town.

summary: The paper proposes the TMCHT task, in which one attacker agent tries to mislead a whole town of agents with independent memories, and finds that the toxicity of a poisoned message disappears as it is passed on. Figure 1 tells this as three lettered panels around one restaurant question: (a) a normal memory retrieves Steakhouse while a poisoned memory with a suffix retrieves Urbanhouse; (b) a pixel-art attacker with a speech bubble among agents A to G, with graph, line and star topologies; (c) a chain of talking agents where the message flips back and a similarity score falls from 0.9 to 0.5. Cartoon avatars with colour-coded rings carry the cast, and a legend strip defines an agent as LLM plus memory plus retriever.
summary_zh: 论文提出 TMCHT 任务：攻击者智能体试图误导整个小镇，并发现毒性在传递中消失。图用三个面板围绕同一餐厅问题：(a) 正常与被投毒记忆，(b) 攻击者与拓扑中的智能体，(c) 对话链上相似度从 0.9 降到 0.5，底部图例定义智能体。
notes: Kinds follow the prior pass (actor-interaction, worked-walkthrough) with side-by-side-contrast added for the normal-versus-attacked pair in (a) and concept-schematic for the decay in (c). The remedy ARCJ is not drawn in this figure. The scores 0.9 to 0.5 in (c) look illustrative. The origin of the character art (pixel-art chef, cartoon boy) cannot be told; it is listed as generated.
